text.jp:
暇のできた折に、なるべく出歩き、この街の
隅々まで確認しているところにござりますが……
text.official_en:
Whenever I have free time, I make a point of seeing
as much of the city as I can.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ボナパルテ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
流石は千年を超える歴史を持つ
帝都ダグシオン、といったところですな。
text.official_en:
It is as breathtaking as one would expect from a city
that has stood for over a thousand years.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ボナパルテ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
見た目の豪華さだけではない、徹底的に
機能性をも追求した街づくりをしているようです。
text.official_en:
Everywhere are signs of being designed for
functionality, not merely for luxury.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ボナパルテ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
この上は、都市の細部までよく観察し、
この頭の中に克明に記憶して帰らねば。
text.official_en:
I must carefully observe even the smallest details
and commit them to the storehouse of my mind.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ボナパルテ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
我が国の、今後の都市作りに応用できる
ものも多くあるやも知れませぬ故。
text.official_en:
I suspect there are lessons here we can apply to our
own kingdom when building new cities.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_トビヤス

text.jp:
大剣闘祭のせいなのかのー、
ダグシオンの中は、いつでも祭りのようだー。
text.official_en:
Might just be because of the Heroic Games, but it
always feels like a party in Dagsion.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_トビヤス
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
老若男女、あらゆる人間が
浮かれて騒いどるわー。
text.official_en:
Guys and gals, young and old, all kinds of folks
having a great time together.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_トビヤス
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
メガエラだと、さすがにこうはいかんー。
こんなのはよっぽどいいことがあった時だけだー。
text.official_en:
It ain't like this in Megaira, that's for sure. Not unless
it's a real special occasion.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_トビヤス
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
そういや、お嬢が女王として即位したときは、
丁度このくらいの賑やかさだったのー。
text.official_en:
Actually, the last time the place was buzzing like this
was at your coronation, boss.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
ユ・ファスさまってー、サラミス以外だと
ホントに嫌われてるんですねー。
text.official_en: People sure hate Yu Phas outside of Saramis.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_リリアン
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
みんな最後には死んじゃうことになるのに
なんででしょうかねー。
text.official_en:
I don't get it. Everyone dies in the end, so what's the
problem with her?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_リリアン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
まー、結局のところアタシたちのほうが
特殊なだけなんでしょうケド。
text.official_en: Whatever it is, I guess we're the weird ones here.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ライサンダー

text.jp:
この街は大まかに
数層に分かれた構造をしているようです。
text.official_en: Broadly speaking, this city is split into several tiers.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ライサンダー
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
上層に行けば行くほど、神殿の影響力が
強まる区画といったところでしょうか。
text.official_en:
I suppose the temples' influence gets stronger as you
ascend to the higher tiers.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ライサンダー
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
逆に、下の層に行くほど、人の営みが
濃くなっていくようですね。
text.official_en:
On the other hand, the lower you go, the denser
the population seems to be.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
お疲れ様です。旗艦トラファルガー号は
現在、整備中であります。
text.official_en:
Greetings. Our flagship, the Trafalgar, is undergoing
maintenance.

text.jp:
先日のセベク大河遡上の際、川底で擦った
船底から浸水する恐れがありましたので。
text.official_en:
The hull scraped the riverbed of the Sobek River as
we sailed it, so we're worried about leaks.

text.jp:
作業が完了次第、水上の移動も可能になります。
しばらくの間お待ち下さい。
text.official_en:
We can set sail again once the repairs are complete.
Until then, I'm sorry, but you'll have to wait.
